body:
v0 was built in a jail and has now been exercised on the host. v0.1 turns it into a release and connects the pieces. HANDOVER.md at the repo root is the working summary; this store holds the reasoning. Read the spine, then the tasks:

  smut r plan-v0-1 --backlinks part-of --select title,status --order seq -i -l 3

No question is open. d-harness-state, q-jail-world and q-licence record the operator's last answers.

WHAT BRIEF-V1 LISTED AS UNVERIFIED
Done on the host: nix flake check --no-build on x86_64-linux, the package and both checks built, elisp ert 8/8, and client death (SIGKILL) surviving in an own scope. Still unverified: a real WM restart, an emacs.service restart, aarch64-darwin.

The repo stays private for now and is expected to go public; .smut/ ships with it.
title: Handoff: v0.1 is planned
